```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for a larger active force to avoid overextension of the military.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to the current Administration's cuts to the National Guard and Reserves.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The men and women of the Guard and Reserve tend to be older and more experienced than their active duty counterparts.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Guard and Reserve forces are currently deployed at historically high rates.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Army Reserve alone has soldiers in 30 countries.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Congress passed the National Defense Authorization Act to ensure troops have what they need.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The National Defense Authorization Act has triggered a veto threat from the Commander-in-Chief.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The National Defense Authorization Act passed with overwhelming bipartisan support in both the House and Senate.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Commander-in-Chief would have members of the Reserve and Guard train on, and potentially be deployed with, equipment that is no longer used by their active duty comrades.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This endangerment of both troops and national security is intolerable.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Recommendation for a permanent line item for National Guard affairs, one that is not eliminated by the President and reinstated by Congress.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The guard is too essential to national defense to be a secondary decision.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
